figures.title: Thermal paper-patterning comparison
figures.summary: Exact heat/time panels remain separate; marker diffusion images describe patterned paper, not CdS particle morphology. Compared with the selected 150 °C / 300 min treatment, the authors report marker diffusion into toner-printed areas at lower temperature or shorter heating duration. This is a qualitative statement about the Figure2 comparison, not a numerical diffusion distance or a universal cutoff assigned to every panel.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
